verdict.rationale: Metorial publishes an OpenAPI spec and SDKs (TS/Python/Go), and a live REST endpoint (api.metorial.com/providers) that returns machine-readable, key-gated responses—clear evidence of a documented, programmatically queryable API. However, the evidence doesn't show explicit documentation of a dedicated 'list/search catalog' or 'discover tools' endpoint distinct from provider/session management, so full registry-discovery semantics aren't confirmed. missing for 10: explicit docs of a catalog/registry search or list-tools endpoint, independent/community confirmation of programmatic discovery use.
